channel.title: Holistic Life | Home Workouts & Healthy Meals
channel.description: Simple home workouts, small-space gym ideas, and easy high-protein meals for busy people. Run by a registered nurse who believes healthy habits should fit real life.

item.title: Walking Pad Buying Checklist: 9 Things to Check Before You Buy
item.description: A walking pad buying checklist with nine things to check before you order: weight limit, belt size, noise, speed, safety features and the return policy. Plain steps from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Small Space Home Gym: What to Buy First, in the Right Order
item.description: Building a small space home gym? Start with a mat, then bands, then adjustable dumbbells, and add a kettlebell or bench only when you are ready. A simple buying order for apartments, with what to look for. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Night Shift Meal Prep: What to Pack for a 12-Hour Shift
item.description: Night shift meal prep made simple. Pack one main meal, two snacks and water, and use a cold bag and ice pack to keep food safe. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with three sample packs. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Meal Prep Gift Ideas: Kitchen Gifts for Someone Who Cooks Ahead
item.description: Meal prep gift ideas for people who batch cook on Sundays. These kitchen gifts make cooking ahead faster, tidier and safer, from locking containers to freezer trays. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: High Protein Dinner Ideas: 5 Easy Recipes Ready in 30 Minutes
item.description: High protein dinner ideas you can make in about 30 minutes. Five simple recipes: sheet pan chicken, a turkey taco skillet, salmon rice bowls, egg fried rice and a white bean soup. Each comes with an easy swap. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for New Nurse Graduates: 10 Ideas for Pinning and Graduation
item.description: Gifts for new nurse graduates that get used from the first shift: compression socks, a badge reel, a work bag and more. Ten ideas for pinning ceremonies and graduation, from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Fitness Stocking Stuffers: 12 Small Gifts for People Who Work Out
item.description: Fitness stocking stuffers that are small enough for a stocking and useful enough to use. Twelve ideas from a nurse-run site, from loop bands and a jump rope to a cooling towel, with notes on what to look for. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Beginner Walking Plan: 4 Weeks From 10 Minutes to 30 Minutes
item.description: A beginner walking plan that builds from 10 minute walks to about 30 minutes in four weeks. Includes a simple weekly table, a talk test for pace and tips for days you miss. Easy to follow and kind to beginners. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Beginner Home Workout With No Equipment: A Gentle 15-Minute Plan
item.description: A beginner home workout with no equipment that takes 15 minutes. Five low-impact moves, easier and harder options for each, and a simple weekly plan. Made for people who have never followed a routine before. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Adjustable Dumbbells Buying Checklist: 8 Things to Check First
item.description: An adjustable dumbbells buying checklist with eight things to check before you order: weight range, small jumps, how fast the weight changes, grip, storage, noise and the return policy. Plain advice from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.
